# Bundled QR encoder

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python QR Code generator by Project Nayuki,
downloaded on 2026-11-09 from:

https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/master/python/qrcodegen.py

It uses only the Python standard library. Its MIT license and copyright notice
are retained at the top of the file. This bundled copy avoids requiring package
installation or network access when generating QR codes.

SHA-256 of the bundled file:
`9f4ed1dd201dcb92b1bc0d6e14f46c754bcff0ce48580c5d7e8ace8f6926c8ef`.
